description.zh: 指定用户在下次登录时是否必须绑定多因素认证设备。
description.en: Specifies whether a multi-factor authentication (MFA) device must be bound to the RAM user upon logon.

description.zh: 指定密码，密码必须符合云账号的密码强度要求。
description.en: The logon password of the RAM user. The password must meet the password strength requirements.

description.zh: 指定用户在登录时是否需要修改密码。
description.en: Specifies whether the RAM user has to change the password upon logon.
The name of the RAM user.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ram update-login-profile --user-name zhangq0000 --password mypassword --password-reset-required true --mfa-bind-required true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ram UpdateLoginProfile --region cn-hangzhou --PasswordResetRequired true --UserName zhangq0000 --MFABindRequired true --Password mypassword
